variants.name: Близко к исходнику
variants.design: Closest to the original14 design: compact swept-back silver hair with tiny low knot, three broad brown horizontal leather chest panels, round bronze clasp near collar, olive cloak falling from one shoulder to knee level, brown bracers. Same relaxed upright simple yew bow on screen right. Prioritize exact stocky Warrior11-like body proportion and coarse pixel size over decorative detail.
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / character redesign. Create ONE corrected pixel-art concept of the female archer in image1. Input1 is the EDIT TARGET/identity: mature adult woman, swept-back silver-gray hair with a small low back knot, olive cloak, bronze round clasp, brown leather chest plates, gloves and boots, wooden bow and small arrow quiver. Keep this recognizable woman, her age, hair color, green/brown palette and class. Input2 (Warrior11) is the STRICT MASTER for proportions, pixel grid/coarseness, rendering and scene composition. Input3 (Defender02) confirms the same compact stocky family. Do not output the men, sword or shield.
Required corrections: image1 woman is too tall, long-legged and smoothly painted. REDRAW, do not merely apply a pixel filter. Match the men's SHORT thick torso, SHORT sturdy legs, large head and broad boots, about 2.8 head-heights tall. Body including hair-to-boots must occupy only 35% of the square image height (approximately440px on a1254px canvas), not the old41%. Shorten the limbs and torso while retaining a large clear head. Her hair-to-boots height must be no greater than Warrior11 relative to the stone tile.
Use the exact apparent coarse pixel-art language of images2/3: deliberate large square stepped pixel clusters, crisp rectangular small dark eyes, flat skin planes, 3 simple shade bands per material, blocky chunky locks of silver hair. Source-sprite feeling about70–76 pixels tall, clean enlarged pixel clusters. NO smooth contour strokes, no finely painted hair strands, no gradients across the body, no soft illustration/anime face, no tiny stippling/dithering or noisy grain. Coarse coherent pixels should describe forms, not random speckling.
One full-body archer, calm ready stance, three-quarter toward screen right, both feet grounded. Use image2's slate stone isometric platform, dark navy backdrop, framing and top-left light; entire tile and figure visible with margins. Match the master camera; do not look down more steeply onto her head. One functional complete wooden bow: continuous curved upper and lower limbs connected through grip, string connects both tips. Both hands anatomically clear and both bow tips uncut; bow no higher than top of her head and lower tip just above ground. No number/text/labels/watermarks in generated image. Preserve palette and identity, make only the following small design variation within the corrected compact silhouette: Closest to the original14 design: compact swept-back silver hair with tiny low knot, three broad brown horizontal leather chest panels, round bronze clasp near collar, olive cloak falling from one shoulder to knee level, brown bracers. Same relaxed upright simple yew bow on screen right. Prioritize exact stocky Warrior11-like body proportion and coarse pixel size over decorative detail.
